name: The Silver Shadow

owner.name: Vellara Moonshade
owner.appearance: Silver-streaked dark hair, mysterious smile, always cleaning a glass that never seems to empty
owner.secret: Former spy for the Veil Archive

daily_special.description: Vellara picks something special based on what she sees in your eyes

quest_hooks.description: Deliver a sealed letter to The Silver Shadow
Help Vellara with a private matter
quest_hooks.unlock: access to secret room and intelligence network

rumors: The Tideward Order is cracking down on Void-tainted shipments lately.
There's a new gang in the Underworks called the Unseen. Nobody knows their leader.
They say the Archon dreams in code now. The Spirefall changed more than just the buildings.
A woman matching your description was asking about you, just last night.
The leyline fees are going up again. Next month, it'll cost double to get to the skydocks.

characters.name: Old Thomas
characters.description: Retired guard who always sits in the corner, tells war stories for coin

characters.name: Mira Cash
characters.description: Traveling trader who arrives with exotic goods weekly

flavor_text.enter: The warm smell of the Shadow welcomes you. A fire crackles in the hearth.
flavor_text.leave: The Shadow's warmth fades behind you. The low ward feels colder now.
flavor_text.rainy: Rain drums steadily on the shutters. The tavern is busier than usual.
